Title: [LSJ] Austin questions, prepare yourself for weirdness

Messages.Author: Ethan Burrow
Messages.Body:
Mike Ooi attempted to "break the game" Thursday, so I have several
questions that may interest other players :

1) A Shadow Court Satyr has an Illusions of the Kindred on him, and he
only has 2 life. Before range, the Satyr uses the Illusions and burns
2 life (which burns the Satyr). Does this negate the effect of the
Illusions, or does the Satyr burn and then you continue with the
effect of Illusions?

2) I wanted to verify that a Lunatic Eruption will 'cripple' an Aabbt
Kindred if Nefertiti is not in play.

3) Must you announce steps taken during your untap and master phases,
or can you just do things as long as no-one objects? By common
courtesy we mostly do, but is it enforcable by the rules?

(i.e. If you just put 2 counters on a vampire that has the rack, but
you don't say anything and no-one really notices....you're not
cheating and everyone may forget you have the rack. However if you
announce 'Jost gains 2 blood from the Rack', the Rack is instantly
taken during that turn. So if behooves you to be subtle if it's
legal)

-------------------------------

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Ethan Burrow wrote:
>
> Mike Ooi attempted to "break the game" Thursday, so I have several
> questions that may interest other players :
>
> 1) A Shadow Court Satyr has an Illusions of the Kindred on him, and he
> only has 2 life. Before range, the Satyr uses the Illusions and burns
> 2 life (which burns the Satyr). Does this negate the effect of the
> Illusions, or does the Satyr burn and then you continue with the
> effect of Illusions?

Except for strikes and actions, cards resolve when played.
You continue with the Illusion combat.

> 2) I wanted to verify that a Lunatic Eruption will 'cripple' an Aabbt
> Kindred if Nefertiti is not in play.

Yes. Must (D) and cannot (D) -> stuck.

> 3) Must you announce steps taken during your untap and master phases,
> or can you just do things as long as no-one objects? By common
> courtesy we mostly do, but is it enforcable by the rules?
>
> (i.e. If you just put 2 counters on a vampire that has the rack, but
> you don't say anything and no-one really notices....you're not
> cheating and everyone may forget you have the rack. However if you
> announce 'Jost gains 2 blood from the Rack', the Rack is instantly
> taken during that turn. So if behooves you to be subtle if it's
> legal)

It's not necessary, I guess.
But if someone puts two blood on Jost, I'd certainly be trying to
figure out why. :-)
If anyone wants everything spelled out, he or she can always ask
questions ("where'd that blood come from?" "what are you doing?")
continually until the players get on board.
